key_findings: Orai1 is a downstream effector of TLR4-NF-κB signaling in spinal astrocytes and promotes LPS-induced TNF-α/IL-6 production.
Orai1 acts as a store-independent Ca2+ leak channel setting basal Ca2+ in astrocytes.
